- Model consistently underestimates prices in early periods (e.g., first 10 days of forecast horizon) — adjust downward bias for short-term outlooks.
- Overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., 70+ to 72+) — cap forecasts at +2.5% above peak or use moving average smoothing.
- Mean reversion bias: model overreacts to recent volatility — apply 3-period moving average to dampen erratic swings.
- Lagged response: model lags true price movements by 2–3 days — shift forecast horizon forward by 1–2 days for next period.
- High variance in late forecast days — reduce volatility in final 5–7 days by applying exponential decay weighting.
